主要内容: On February 24, 2012, Kentucky Bancshares Inc. announced its quarterly cash dividend to shareholders. The dividend amount was set at 23 cents per share, representing an increase from the previous quarter's 22 cents per share. The dividend payment was scheduled to be made on March 30, 2012, to shareholders of record as of March 20, 2012. This announcement was included in a press release dated February 24, 2012, which was filed as Exhibit 99.1. The company's Chief Financial Officer, Gregory J. Dawson, signed the report on behalf of the registrant.
